data.title: 提丰 · 咖啡店给你留了靠窗位
data.description: 街角咖啡店里，提丰穿松绿绞花针织与黑色连裤袜的完整便装，坐在窗边双人桌的一侧。她把对面椅子轻轻拉开，抬头看向刚到的你；桌上两杯热饮还冒着气，围巾收在椅背上。
data.location: 街角咖啡店窗边双人桌
data.action: 坐着拉开对面的空椅子，抬头迎接镜头
data.promptProse: Typhon sits beside the cafe window in her forest-green cable-knit casual outfit and black tights. She pulls the opposite chair outward for the arriving viewer and raises her eyes in greeting. The eye-level cowboy view includes her seated posture, the partly drawn-out chair and two steaming drinks on the table. Her scarf hangs from the chair back. The tabletop narrows toward the window, and the sill continues behind her to the next seating bay. Soft daylight catches raised knit stitches and the two cup rims. The moving chair casts a diagonal shadow over the floor, while a gentler shadow under her forearm keeps the table contact clear.
